answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy employs a high-stake Proof-of-Identity. Each agent must lock substantial native tokens, acting as a digital lantern illuminating its unique presence. An attacker forging multiple identities incurs prohibitive costs, akin to sourcing vast timber for countless, separate constructs. This economic barrier effectively carves a deep canyon between genuine participants and malicious actors, making large-scale Sybil attacks infeasible.
